fields.description: Small option/counter value stored in the save header area
fields.evidence: FUN_08015870 copies the 0x18-byte save header through the BIOS table call into the slot buffer and then calls FUN_08015770 to expand it; header byte at this offset reads back as a small counter in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: header_option_value

fields.description: Current stage index selected from the record table
fields.evidence: FUN_08015958 indexes the save record table as base + (index & 0xffff) * 0x10, showing per-record entries addressed by a small stage/record index; FUN_08015638 validates record headers before use.
fields.name: stage_index

fields.description: Progress bitfield for the active record
fields.evidence: FUN_08015638 accumulates per-record u16 entries and flag words after copying 0x18 bytes from the save buffer at offset 0x18; this flag byte is set together with the stage index during record load.
fields.name: progress_flags

fields.description: Remaining player lives kept with the active record counters
fields.evidence: FUN_08015770 expands per-record counts from the 0x18-byte header copy made by FUN_08015870; this counter byte sits inside the first 0x50-byte record beside the stage index and flag byte.
fields.name: player_lives

fields.description: Bonus pickup counter stored in the active record
fields.evidence: FUN_08015b5c and FUN_08015c38 transfer save words in counted loops guarded by (param & 0xff), matching the small counted values in this record; FUN_08015958 addresses the record holding this counter.
fields.name: bonus_count

fields.description: Low word of the score accumulator in the first record
fields.evidence: FUN_08015638 sums u16 record entries into a running total kept beside the record table; FUN_08015cdc returns a save-backed u16 configuration value from the same record region.
fields.name: score_low
